लेलिह, अस्, m. (fr. the Intens.), ‘constantly licking,’
a kind of parasitical worm; a serpent, snake; (आ), f. a
particular Mudrā or position of the fingers.

लेलिहत्, अत्, अती, अत्, constantly licking or playing
with the tongue.

लेलिहान, अस्, आ, अम्, frequently licking or darting
out the tongue; (अस्), m. a snake, serpent; epithet
of Śiva; (आ), f. a particular Mudrā or position of
the fingers.

लेलिह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, constantly darting out
the tongue.
लेल्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens., Vopa-deva

लेलया, ind. (probably to be connected with ले-
लाय above, though formed fr. the Intens. of rt.
1. ली), Ved. quivering, flickering, shaking about.

लीयत, लेलायितुम्, Ved. to move to and fro, quiver,
flicker, tremble, quake, shake; [cf. लेलया.]
लेलायमाना, f. one of the seven tongues of fire.
